name: calendar-external-guest-guard
title: Calendar External Guest Guard
description: Names guests outside your domains (and a colleague's personal Gmail used for their work address), then lists what they get under Google Calendar defaults: internal agenda lines, file names, open-link files, the guest list, edit rights. Fixes, Undo, second press to send.

meta.stops: Internal agenda shared with outside guests
meta.summary: Shows what outside guests on an internal invite will actually see, so an agenda, file or guest list isn't shared beyond your domain by mistake.
catches: Guests outside your domains, and personal addresses standing in for a colleague's work address
Agenda lines that contain sensitive terms
Attachments whose names show, or that anyone with the link can open
Guest list, invite-others and modify-event rights given to outside guests
Recurring events, where outside guests get every future occurrence
limits: Models Google Calendar's sharing defaults; other calendar products behave differently
File access comes from what you pass (Drive link settings), not a live Drive check
Personal-address matching uses the directory you provide
a11y: Guest remove buttons have aria-labels with the address
Send sets aria-busy while sending and is described by the second-press hint
Escape disarms the second press and returns focus to Send
Failures use role="alert"; status updates role="status"
